Method of Attack: Phishing-as-a-Service platform targeting Microsoft 365 users by sending phishing emails with HTML attachments containing obfuscated JavaScript that fetches a phishing page mimicking the Microsoft 365 login page, capturing credentials and session cookies, including handling MFA prompts to steal authenticated session cookies.
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with HTML attachments containing obfuscated JavaScript
Phishing page proxying authentication to Microsoft 365
Telegram channel or web panel for delivering stolen session cookies
Indicators of Compromise: Obfuscated JavaScript code executed in browser
Phishing pages injecting company logos and backgrounds from real Microsoft 365 login pages
Use of Telegram bot to deliver valid session cookies
